The payload was therefore diffed rather than trusted to the manifest, as that incident requires, and a cache-busted re-fetch (x-cache: Miss from cloudfront) returned a byte-identical body, ruling out CDN variance. Selection whitelisted categoryType in {dps, hps, tank} PLUS sortField === "lowerBound" PLUS keyRange === undefined out of the 44 blocks, giving 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows with 0 unmatched (melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and were excluded rather than merely blacklisting "dungeon"). All 40 lowerBound values moved and all 40 numberOfCharacters counts fell (the population sample shrank roughly 5-18% across the roster); the largest value move is Frost DK +1.97% (315.6 -> 321.1) and the family median moved +1.2%, far under maxValueMovePct 0.6 and maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35, so no value_move_ack is involved. Merged at the source's own 1-decimal precision. asOf stays the source-published snapshotDate 2026-09-15 and was NOT advanced to today or to the Last-Modified date — that is the documented rule for this source and the reason the row is partial: 2026-09-15 is 7 days old, inside the contract's maxAgeDays 8 but outside the 1-day success window. Its published LETTERS are not ingested and must not be; lowerBound is a population MEAN, not a ceiling.
